children: Moody's Ratings revised the Arthur J. Gallagher's

rating outlook to positive from stable on Tuesday after the insurance broker reduced its financial leverage since acquiring AssuredPartners. The ratings firm also noted AJG's record of profitable growth and healthy free cash flow.
long-term issuer rating and senior unsecured debt rating were affirmed at Baa2. Its provisional Baa2 senior unsecured shelf rating was also affirmed.

"Gallagher ranks among the world's three largest insurance brokerage and consulting firms based on revenue," Moody's said. "We expect the company to continue expanding through a combination of organic growth and acquisitions, which it funds through a mix of internally generated cash, debt, and stock to help manage its financial leverage."
stock rose 2.9% in afternoon trading, along with other broker/risk management firms. Brown & Brown
